main_text.l: פמב פּוּמְבִּי Ch. Pompa, πόμπη: בְּפוּמְבִּי Cum pompa, publicè palàm, aperte.
פמל פַּמְלִיא פַּמְלִיא Ch. Familia, Cant.1.15.

פנא פְּנִי, פְּנָה Ch. Aspicere, respicere, spectare: vertere, avertere, convertere se, divertere se, inclinare, declinare. Syr.Fut. יִפְנֵן Revertetur, Matt. 10.13. & 15.23. Ithpehal אִתְפְּנִי Ch. Idem. Pahel פַּנֵּי Ch. Parare, præparare: Everrere, purgare, expedire, amovere, removere: Syris verò est, respondere. Aph. אַפְנִי Ch. Respicere; respicere facere, inclinare, declinare, declinare facere, abducere, removere. Syriac. Convertere, obvertere, restituere, Lucæ 1.16. Matth. 5.39. Act.1.6.2. ad Cor. 7.10. Ethpahel אִתְפְּנִי Converti, convertere se.
פְּנָא Syr. Conversio, Act.15.3. Cū Aff. ܦܢܝܘܬܐ, ad Rom.11.15.
פַּנֵּי Ch. Vacuus, vacans, immunis, otiosus.

פנך פּוּנְדְּקָא פּוּנְדָּק Chal. Hospes, Caupo, Græc. πανδοχεὺς vel πανδοχῶν, vel πανδοκὸς: Item Hospitium, diversorium, caupona. Pl. פּוּנְדְּקִין, Num.24.14. Jon. const. פּוּנְדְּקִי, Exo.14.2. in Jon. quomodo etiam legendum videtur, Num.33.8. in T. Jon. ut est versu præcedenti in T.H.Fœmin. פּוּנְדְּקִיתָא Hospita, caupona, Græc. πανδοκεῖα. Plur. פּוּנְדְּקָן.
פּוּנְדְּקָתָא Ch. Idem, בְּתֵּי פּוּנְדְּקָתָא Hospitia, Genes. 42.6.
